def transaction(self) -> Iterator[None]:
        existing = self._current()
        if existing is not None:
            yield
            return
        session = self._session_factory()
        self._local.session = session
        try:
            with session.begin():
                session.execute(text(_STORE_LOCK_SQL))
                yield
        finally:
            session.close()
            self._local.session = None
